definitions.def: a state in which all activity or movement has stopped
the beginning of something, especially something unpleasant
to continue to exist or happen for a long time
following one after another in order, without a break
to change to the opposite direction or order

grammar_choice.en_template: Evolution {{1:will come/will be come}} to a standstill until something in the conditions {{2:changes/change}}: the onset of an ice age, a change in the average rainfall of the area, a shift in the prevailing wind.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 진화는 조건 속의 무언가가 바뀔 때까지 정지 상태에 이른다. 즉 빙하기의 도래, 그 지역 평균 강우량의 변화, 탁월풍의 이동 같은 것 말이다.
explain: come은 자동사 — 수동태(be come) 불가, 미래 능동 will come.
주어 something은 단수 → 3인칭 단수 동사 changes.

grammar_choice.en_template: Such changes {{1:do happen/do happens}} when we {{2:are dealing/dealing}} with a timescale as long as the evolutionary one.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그러한 변화는 진화적 시간만큼이나 긴 시간 척도를 다룰 때에는 실제로 일어난다.
explain: 강조의 do + 동사원형 — do happen(do happens 아님).
when절의 진행 동사 — be동사 필요, are dealing.

grammar_choice.en_template: As a consequence, evolution normally does not come to a halt, {{1:but/and}} constantly {{2:tracks/track}} the changing environment.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그 결과, 진화는 보통 멈추는 것이 아니라, 변화하는 환경을 끊임없이 추적한다.
explain: not A but B 상관접속 — 대조의 but.

grammar_choice.en_template: If there is a steady downward drift in the average temperature in the area, a drift {{1:that/what}} persists over centuries, successive generations of animals {{2:will be propelled/will propel}} by a steady selection 'pressure' in the direction, say, of {{3:growing/grow}} longer coats of hair.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 만약 그 지역 평균 기온에 꾸준한 하강 흐름, 즉 수 세기에 걸쳐 지속되는 흐름이 있다면, 잇따른 세대의 동물들은 가령 더 긴 털을 기르는 방향으로 꾸준한 선택 '압력'에 의해 추동될 것이다.
explain: 선행사 a drift 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 that(선행사 있으므로 what 불가).
generations가 압력에 '추동되는' 대상 → 수동태 will be propelled.

grammar_choice.en_template: If after a few thousand years of reduced temperature the trend reverses and average temperatures creep up again, the animals will come under the influence of a new selection pressure, and {{1:will be pushed/will push}} towards {{2:growing/to grow}} shorter coats again.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 만약 수천 년의 기온 하강 후에 그 추세가 역전되어 평균 기온이 다시 서서히 올라가면, 그 동물들은 새로운 선택 압력의 영향을 받게 되고, 다시 더 짧은 털을 기르는 쪽으로 떠밀릴 것이다.
explain: 동물이 '떠밀리는' 대상 → 수동태 will be pushed.

jumble.answer: Evolution will come to a standstill until something in the conditions changes: the onset of an ice age, a change in the average rainfall of the area, a shift in the prevailing wind.
Such changes do happen when we are dealing with a timescale as long as the evolutionary one.
As a consequence, evolution normally does not come to a halt, but constantly tracks the changing environment.

If there is a steady downward drift in the average temperature in the area, a drift that persists over centuries, successive generations of animals will be propelled by a steady selection 'pressure' in the direction, say, of growing longer coats of hair.

If after a few thousand years of reduced temperature the trend reverses and average temperatures creep up again, the animals will come under the influence of a new selection pressure, and will be pushed towards growing shorter coats again.
